quarterly_data.quarter: Meta IR presentation: Q3 2026 Earnings Call (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, revenue by user geography (page 3 chart, apportioned by Meta's estimate of where users are when they generate revenue): US & Canada $28,905 million, Europe $14,462 million, Asia-Pacific $11,890 million, Rest of World $9,344 million (versus $21,751 million, $12,268 million, $10,272 million and $6,951 million in Q3'25). Family average revenue per person (ARPP, page 11 chart) was $17.72 in Q3'26, versus $16.86 in Q2'26 and $14.46 in Q3'25.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3'26 revenue US & Canada $28,905 million; Europe $14,462 million; Asia-Pacific $11,890 million; Rest of World $9,344 million; ARPP $17.72

quarterly_data.quarter: Meta IR presentation: Q3 2026 Earnings Call (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, ad metrics by user geography (pages 12 and 13 charts): ad impressions delivered grew 8% in US & Canada, 8% in Europe, 14% in Asia-Pacific and 8% in Rest of World year over year (10% worldwide); average price per ad grew 23% in US & Canada, 10% in Europe, 1% in Asia-Pacific and 24% in Rest of World (14% worldwide).
quarterly_data.figure: price per ad +23% US & Canada, +10% Europe, +1% Asia-Pacific, +24% Rest of World; impressions +14% Asia-Pacific

quarterly_data.quarter: Meta IR presentation: Q3 2026 Earnings Call (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, costs and capital spending (page 5 and page 9 charts): expenses as a percentage of revenue in Q3'26 were cost of revenue 21%, research and development 31%, marketing and sales 5% and general and administrative 23% (versus 18%, 30%, 6% and 7% in Q3'25). Year-to-date capital expenditures (purchases of property and equipment plus principal payments on finance leases) were $85,824 million in 2026 versus $50,078 million in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 YTD capex $85,824 million (2025 YTD $50,078 million); Q3'26 cost of revenue 21% of revenue, R&D 31%, G&A 23%
